data.name: Autoimmune cytopenia
data.description: Immune-mediated destruction of blood cell lineages (including Evans syndrome and pure red cell aplasia) in which sirolimus is used as a T-cell-directed therapy.
data.description_beginner: A group of conditions in which the immune system attacks and destroys the body's own blood cells. Because rapamycin (sirolimus) calms overactive T cells, it is used as a treatment when the standard drugs do not work.
